definitions.explanation: What remains after something has passed or ended; vestiges of the past.

definitions.gloss: reluctance to part; attachment at parting
definitions.explanation: The feeling of sadness or reluctance when separating from someone or something.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From {波|な}{残|ごり} (waves remaining) - originally the traces left on the shore after waves recede.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {名残|なごり}⟦{惜|お}しい→惜しい：10243_oshii⟧ (reluctant to part, sad to leave)
- {名残|なごり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ (lingering snow of late winter)
- {名残|なごり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しむ→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧ (to be reluctant to part)
- ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名残|なごり} (remnants of winter)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{名残|なごり} evokes a poetic sense of transience and the bittersweet feelings associated with endings. It's often used in seasonal references ({名残|なごり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧, the last cherry blossoms).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{面影|おもかげ}→面影：06631_omokage⟧ (traces, vestiges) - focuses on visual memory or resemblance
- {名残|なごり} - broader, includes physical traces and emotional attachment
